judgements.justification: B's area chair set aside PpQM's 3 as nonsensical but spent the meta-review defending acceptance against it and never weighed tier, while A, with no detractor, got a spotlight.
No reviewer or area chair in either committee raised audience breadth or venue fit.

A's meta-review says the reviewers all called the method 'clever' (none did) and that robustness was 'not a major focus of the reviewers', though t8ZX called it 'weak' and uhXk 'a by-product', and the spotlight rests on that account.
A's reviewers never replied, but B's reviewers did not revise either, and A's unrevised scores were already at the top of the range, so this does not drive the split.
No reviewer said they could not verify the results; confidences are 3 to 5 and 7tWD's thin 7 is inattention, not declared non-expertise.
Neither committee split evenly between accept and reject; B's only reject was a discarded outlier.
The authors gave both committees the same fine-tuning table and the same concession on robustness; no conflicting accounts are recorded.
No novelty verdict in either committee rested on a wrong account of prior work.
A's spotlight on 7/6/7 has no stated basis; the three-sentence meta-review gives no argument for the tier and no reviewer argued for one.
No reviewer objected to the paper's framing from a neighbouring field's premises.
No reviewer in either committee rated above 7, and A's 7s include the light 7tWD review, so neither committee had an engaged champion well above accept.
Both committees accepted; no one judged promised revisions too large for camera-ready.
B's area chair cited another reviewer's agreement only to discard the outlier; no off-record assessment settled an open split.
Both committees judged the paper as a method paper by the same throughput and robustness criteria.
PpQM's 3 rested on misreadings of the core method, not a peripheral point, and B's area chair discarded it rather than counting it at full weight.
